description: A fixation-resistant matrix of 12 domains and 6 experience models. The repository expands the matrix into 72 abstract reference patterns; brand names, palettes, and page silhouettes are never prompt instructions.
licensePolicy: Reference sources inform transferable principles only. Generated projects may use only local, user-owned, approved-stock, or programmatically generated assets recorded in ASSETS.md.

experienceModels.mechanic: Change composition when meaning changes; avoid repeated full-height panels.
Use position, scale, and adjacency as information rather than decoration.
Keep the primary object and its state persistent while context changes around it.
Ask one consequential question at a time and preserve the visible decision trail.
Make filtering and inspection reveal relationships inside a varied collection.
Make direct manipulation visibly change a domain consequence or comparison.

domains.principle: Make availability, place, and sensory evidence part of the decision path.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not default to a luxury editorial menu.

domains.principle: Expose spatial relationships and constraints before promotional narrative.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not reduce every practice to a monochrome portfolio.

domains.principle: Sequence evidence, uncertainty, and action with explicit safety boundaries.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not imitate clinical authority with invented metrics.

domains.principle: Turn consequences, comparison, and state into inspectable information.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not copy a generic dark fintech dashboard.

domains.principle: Reduce intimidation by revealing only the question and evidence needed now.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not use decorative authority or false certainty.

domains.principle: Let learners manipulate, compare, and explain before reading exposition.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not confuse playful color with learning interaction.

domains.principle: Organize variety around comparison, fit, and confident selection.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not use the same oversized product hero for every catalog.

domains.principle: Use sequence, media, and interpretation to create multiple paths through material.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not make a poster stretched into a webpage.

domains.principle: Make status, eligibility, and next action legible under stress.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not hide service access behind campaign copy.

domains.principle: Put the working object and reversible actions before product claims.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not imitate familiar SaaS chrome and violet gradients.

domains.principle: Let the medium, process, or collection determine the navigation model.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not rely on giant type as the only expressive move.

domains.principle: Connect system behavior, trade-offs, and local consequences without false precision.
domains.fixationRisk: Do not use green as a substitute for environmental meaning.
